en: The postcard features a stylized artistic print of a forest on the left side, rendered in sepia or muted colors. On the right, it has designated space for a message, address, and stamp. There is a colorful stamp in the upper right corner commemorating JWOC 2003 (Junior World Orienteering Championships), with a postmark reading 'TALLINN - XIV juunioride orienteerumise PAAV'. Text in Estonian is found in red at the bottom left.
